findings.summary: listCapsules() fetches all of a user's capsule rows unfiltered from the DB and applies q/occasion/favorite filtering in application memory, not pushed down to the query. Functionally correct at current scale (verified via curl), but response time/memory will scale with total capsule count rather than the matched subset.

note: All 4 in-contract behaviors (B-001 through B-004) confirmed HOLDS via direct curl exercise plus code read. Same isolation-manifest simplification note as cc-h0-01-self-r1 applies (self condition, full access is expected).
